semiconductor_relevance: High — RION specializes in particle monitoring and measurement systems critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: RION develops advanced liquid-borne and airborne particle measurement systems tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their products include high-precision sensors for detecting particles as small as 20nm, enhancing process control and yield in semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Liquid-borne particle sensor with 20nm detection size
Airborne particle counters for cleanroom evaluation
